failureUi.retryHint: Once the cause is fixed you can send the same request again.

task_timeout.title: The task did not finish in time.
task_timeout.cause: The task ran past its time limit. A busy node or slow disk or network can cause this.
task_timeout.fix:
Check the node's CPU and disk load.
Try again in a moment.

task_interrupted.title: The node's Orbivisor service restarted during the task.
task_interrupted.cause: orbivisord restarted while running the task (update, reboot or crash) and lost its work.
task_interrupted.fix:
Check that the node is online again.
Run the same task again.

node_offline.title: Node {{node}} did not respond, so the task never started.
node_offline.cause: Node {{node}}, which was to run the task, is off or unreachable; the task was failed after waiting.
node_offline.fix:
Check {{node}}'s status and network on the Nodes page.
Try again once the node is back.

node_not_member.title: Node {{node}} is not in the cluster.
node_not_member.cause: The node was removed from the cluster or is not a member.
node_not_member.fix: Check the available nodes on the Nodes page and try again with another node.

node_no_peers.title: This node cannot reach other nodes.
node_no_peers.cause: The node has no cluster link to other nodes (it runs alone).
node_no_peers.fix: Check on the Cluster page that the node has joined the cluster.

storage_full.title: Out of disk space.
storage_full.cause: The file system ran out of space while writing.
storage_full.fix:
Check free space on the Storage pools page.
Delete unused volumes, snapshots or backups, or pick another pool, then try again.

pool_not_found.title: Storage pool {{pool}} does not exist.
pool_not_found.cause: The pool the task needed was deleted or has a different name.
pool_not_found.fix: Check the pool name on the Storage pools page and try again with an existing pool.

pool_not_ready.title: Storage pool {{pool}} is not ready on node {{node}}.
pool_not_ready.cause: The pool is not mounted on that node (for example NFS) or is not set up for it.
pool_not_ready.fix:
Check {{pool}}'s per-node state on the Storage pools page.
Fix the mount, then try again.

pool_full.title: Storage pool {{pool}} on node {{node}} is too full.
pool_full.cause: The task needs {{need}} but only {{free}} is free.
pool_full.fix: Free up space in {{pool}} (unused volumes, snapshots) or pick a pool with more room, then try again.

target_deleted.title: The target was deleted during the task.
target_deleted.cause: Someone deleted the VM or volume the task was working on.
target_deleted.fix: Check whether the target still exists. If the delete was intended, nothing else is needed.

target_busy.title: {{name}} is busy with another task.
target_busy.cause: Another task on the same target (snapshot, backup, start, stop …) has not finished.
target_busy.fix: Wait for that task to finish in the task history, then try again.

volume_in_use.title: Volume {{volume}} is attached to VM {{vm}}.
volume_in_use.cause: A disk that a VM uses cannot be deleted.
volume_in_use.fix: Detach the disk from VM {{vm}}, then delete it again.

qemu_start_failed.title: VM {{vm}} could not start.
qemu_start_failed.cause: The virtual machine program (QEMU) exited right after starting. The raw message below has QEMU's reason.
qemu_start_failed.fix:
Read QEMU's error in the raw message below (missing disk or ISO file, not enough memory, device settings …).
Fix the VM settings and start it again.

vm_not_running.title: VM {{vm}} is not running.
vm_not_running.cause: Only a running VM can be moved live to another node.
vm_not_running.fix: Start the VM and move it again, or change its node while it is off.

migration_tls_missing.title: The move cannot be encrypted (TLS).
migration_tls_missing.cause: This node's QEMU was built without TLS support (no GnuTLS). Moving between nodes needs encryption.
migration_tls_missing.fix:
Install a QEMU package with GnuTLS support on the node (the QEMU Orbivisor ships).
Restart the VM, then move it again.

migration_target_refused.title: Node {{node}} could not receive VM {{vm}}.
migration_target_refused.cause: The receiving node refused during preparation (the raw message has the reason — disks, devices, QEMU version …).
migration_target_refused.fix:
Read the receiving node's reason in the raw message below.
Check node {{node}}, then try again or pick another node.

migration_no_port.title: The receiving node has no free migration port.
migration_no_port.cause: Other migrations use all ports or the port range is small.
migration_no_port.fix:
Try again after the other moves finish.
If it keeps happening, widen the migration port range.

migration_storage_not_shared.title: VM {{vm}}'s disks could not be opened together with node {{node}}.
migration_storage_not_shared.cause: The shared storage lock (for example shared LVM) could not be switched to shared use by both nodes.
migration_storage_not_shared.fix:
Check that the storage pool is ready on both nodes.
Try again in a moment.

migration_vm_stopped.title: VM {{vm}} was stopped during the move.
migration_vm_stopped.cause: Someone asked to stop the VM while it was moving; it was not started on the receiving node.
migration_vm_stopped.fix: Start the VM and move it again if needed.

backup_store_unavailable.title: Backup store {{store}} could not be reached.
backup_store_unavailable.cause: The store (S3, NFS …) did not answer or the connection dropped.
backup_store_unavailable.fix:
Check {{store}}'s state and address on the Backup stores page.
Try again once it is reachable.

backup_store_denied.title: Backup store {{store}} denied access.
backup_store_denied.cause: The credentials (access key) are wrong or the bucket policy blocks access.
backup_store_denied.fix: Check the keys and bucket permissions in the backup store settings.

backup_corrupt.title: Data in backup store {{store}} is corrupt.
backup_corrupt.cause: A chunk failed its check (disk damage or a file changed underneath).
backup_corrupt.fix:
Run a verify on the backup store to find the broken backups.
Restore from another point in time or take a new backup.

backup_key_mismatch.title: The encryption key does not match backup store {{store}}.
backup_key_mismatch.cause: The key set in this cluster differs from the key the store was created with.
backup_key_mismatch.fix: Enter the encryption key the store was created with.

restore_name_taken.title: The VM name {{name}} is already used.
restore_name_taken.cause: A VM with the same name exists, so nothing was restored.
restore_name_taken.fix: Restore under another name or rename the existing VM.

upload_checksum.title: The downloaded file's checksum does not match.
upload_checksum.cause: The file was damaged in transit, or the checksum given belongs to another file.
upload_checksum.fix:
Check the checksum on the publisher's site.
Download again.

download_failed.title: The file could not be downloaded.
download_failed.cause: {{url}} answered with an error or the node could not reach it.
download_failed.fix:
Check the address and that the node can reach the internet (or that server).
Download again.

image_unsupported.title: Unsupported image format.
image_unsupported.cause: A non-ISO file was imported as ISO, or the image cannot stand alone (descriptor-only VMDK, qcow2 with a backing file).
image_unsupported.fix: Check the file format. Use a VMDK with its -flat data file, or a single merged qcow2 (qemu-img convert).

apply_step_failed.title: Apply step {{step}} ({{kind}} {{name}}) failed.
apply_step_failed.fix:
Fix the YAML file as the reason says.
Apply again — only what is left is done.

apply_conflict.title: {{kind}} {{name}} changed during the apply.
apply_conflict.cause: Someone or something changed the item after the plan was made; it was not overwritten.
apply_conflict.fix: Review the change, make the plan again (preview) and apply.

apply_plan_expired.title: The plan to apply is gone.
apply_plan_expired.cause: Plans are kept only briefly; it expired or the node restarted.
apply_plan_expired.fix: Make the plan again with preview and apply it right away.

vmware_unreachable.title: vCenter/ESXi could not be reached.
vmware_unreachable.cause: The address is wrong, a firewall or network blocks it, or it answered too slowly.
vmware_unreachable.fix:
Check the address in the VMware connection settings and that the node reaches port 443.
Try again.

vmware_auth.title: vCenter/ESXi rejected the login.
vmware_auth.cause: The user name or password is wrong, or the account is locked.
vmware_auth.fix: Enter the account again in the VMware connection settings.

package_install_failed.title: Packages could not be installed on node {{node}}.
package_install_failed.cause: dnf/apt failed (repository unreachable, version conflict … — see the raw message).
package_install_failed.fix:
Check that node {{node}} reaches its package repositories.
Fix the reason in the raw message and try again.

ceph_no_quorum.title: The Ceph monitors did not reach quorum.
ceph_no_quorum.cause: The new monitor on node {{node}} could not join the others (network, firewall or clock).
ceph_no_quorum.fix:
Check the monitors on the Ceph page.
Check ports 6789/3300 between nodes and the clock (NTP), then try again.

sdn_not_ready.title: SDN (OVN) is not ready yet.
sdn_not_ready.cause: SDN setup has not finished or there is no OVN central.
sdn_not_ready.fix: Check the setup on the SDN page and try again when it is ready.

ha_node_failed.title: Node {{node}} failed, so this task was not done.
ha_node_failed.cause: HA restarted the VM on another node; tasks left on the failed node are ended as failed.
ha_node_failed.fix: Check that the VM runs on its new node. Run the task again if still needed.

node_metric.cause: A node metric (CPU, memory, disk, network) crossed the rule's threshold.
node_metric.fix: See what uses it on the Nodes page; move VMs to another node or add capacity.

vm_metric.cause: A VM metric crossed the rule's threshold.
vm_metric.fix: Check the VM's charts for when it started; look inside the guest or give it more CPU or memory.

pool_usage.cause: A storage pool is nearly full.
pool_usage.fix: Delete unused volumes, snapshots or backups, or grow the pool. A full pool stops VM writes.

node_offline.cause: A node stopped answering the cluster.
node_offline.fix: Check the node's power and network. HA VMs restart on other nodes after the set time.

vm_failed.fix: Read the last error on the VM summary, fix it and start the VM again.

task_failed.fix: Open the task in the task history to see the cause and fix.

ha_recovery.cause: HA restarted a VM on another node.
ha_recovery.fix: Check the failed node; when it is back, decide whether to move the VM back.

backup_job_failed.fix: See the failed VMs and causes of the last run on the Backup schedules page.

backup_verify_failed.cause: Backup verification found a broken backup.
backup_verify_failed.fix: Do not restore from it; take a new backup and check the store's disks.

backup_store_unavailable.cause: A backup store cannot be reached.
backup_store_unavailable.fix: Check the store's address, credentials and network. Backups fail meanwhile.

certificate_expiring.fix: Renew it on the Certificates page or check its automatic renewal (ACME).

certificate_renew_failed.fix: See the last order task's cause on the Certificates page (DNS or HTTP validation …).

node_link_down.cause: A node network link is down.
node_link_down.fix: Check the cable and switch port. A bond keeps running on its other links.

bond_degraded.cause: Part of a network bond is down.
bond_degraded.fix: Check the failed link's cable and switch port. One more failure can isolate the node.

dr_rpo_exceeded.cause: DR replication is behind its recovery point objective (RPO).
dr_rpo_exceeded.fix: See the late VMs and replication errors on the recovery plan page; check the remote link and bandwidth.

dr_run_failed.cause: A DR run (test or failover) failed.
dr_run_failed.fix: See the failed step and VMs on the DR run page.

apply_set_drift.cause: An apply set drifted from the live settings.
apply_set_drift.fix: See the drifted items on the apply set page; apply again or update the YAML.

sdn_quorum_lost.fix: Find and bring back the down central nodes on the SDN page. Network changes are blocked meanwhile.

sdn_central_down.fix: Check that node's OVN service and network.

sdn_chassis_down.cause: A node's SDN agent (ovn-controller) is down.
sdn_chassis_down.fix: Check ovn-controller on that node; its VMs may lose SDN networking.

sdn_gateway_unavailable.cause: No node can host a router's external gateway.
sdn_gateway_unavailable.fix: Check the gateway nodes' external network links.

sdn_gateway_failover.cause: A router gateway failed over to another node.
sdn_gateway_failover.fix: Check the original node; external traffic continues.

sdn_sync_failed.cause: SDN settings could not be synced to OVN.
sdn_sync_failed.fix: See the last sync error on the SDN page.

sdn_physnet_not_ready.cause: A physical network is not ready on a node.
sdn_physnet_not_ready.fix: Check that network's bridge and NIC in the node's network settings.

sdn_lb_member_down.cause: A load balancer member is not answering.
sdn_lb_member_down.fix: Check that VM and its service port.

dr_source_returned.fix: Plan a failback on the recovery plan page; make sure the same VMs do not run on both sites.
